content: उत्कल {%a.%} Excessive, piteous; <ls>K. 306</ls>. .{@-लः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of a country, the modern Orissa, or the inhabitants of that country (<ab>pl.</ab>); जगन्नाथप्रान्तदेश उत्कलः परिकीर्तितः; see ओड्र; उत्कलादर्शितपथः <ls>R. 4. 38</ls>. .²2 A fowler, bird-catcher. .²3 A porter (carrying a load with him). .²4 A subdivision of Brāhmaṇas.
